Maya (support): seeing a spike of 502/504s from eu1 hosted api since ~11:12 UTC. ~10% of short requests (<200ms) are failing. affected tenant: acme-inc. curl sample below
Corey (eng-sre): can you drop a trace id and any sample request ids? also any deploys in last few hours?
Maya (support): trace id -> trace-0a1b2c3d. no deploys shown in deploy-bot for eu1. here is the curl we used:
```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://eu1.api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"input":"hi"}'```
EdgeBot: deploys: none to eu1 in the last 6h :white_check_mark:
Jules (prod-oncall): i'm seeing envoy logs for that trace showing upstream_reset + RST_STREAM for h2. also nginx upstream timed out on a handful of backends.
Lina (support-eng): any auth rotation / billing header churn events? could be authcache TTL flapping causing head-of-line stalls. :thinking_face:
Corey (eng-sre): checking LB/edge metrics now — subset of midproxy pool has elevated 5xx and slow response headers. suspicious circuit-breaker tripped on midproxy under a brief flurry of connections. rolling a quick rollback of circuit params to previous values (h2 window + max concurrent) to see impact.
Maya (support): repro steps for customer if helpful: 1) small prompt 2) `curl -X POST -d '{"input":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://eu1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> sometimes returns 504 after TCP/TLS established.
Jules (prod-oncall): short mitigation: ask customer to set header `X-Edge-Priority: reserved` to route around affected midproxy pool, and enable client retry with jitter for 502/504s. i'll keep oncall watching.
Corey (eng-sre): rollback applied at 11:29 UTC. watching error-rate and p50/p95 for eu1. :eyes:
Lina (support-eng): please paste envoy log snippet and nginx upstream log (request_id) for trace-0a1b2c3d so i can correlate.
Maya (support): pasted logs here:
```[envoy error] upstream_reset: stream reset by peer, details: FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR
nginx: 2026/11/04 11:12:34 [error] 12345#0: *987654 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.1.2.3, server: eu1.api.redwood.ai, request: "POST /v1/generate HTTP/2.0", upstream: "http://10.20.30.40:8080/", host: "eu1.api.redwood.ai", request_id: trace-0a1b2c3d```
Jules (prod-oncall): follow-up: after rolling back circuit thresholds the error rate dropped back to baseline within ~4 minutes. leaving mitigations in place for now and creating INF ticket INF-4321 to investigate h2 window sizing vs circuit tripping. :white_check_mark:
Maya (support): customer notified, they're okay with the mitigating header and want a postmortem. thx all for quick turnaround.
